title: Transsion's Speaker-Attributed Multilingual ASR System for the MLC-SLM 2026 Challenge
abstract: arXiv:2609.20833v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents the Transsion Speech Team submission to Task 1 of the MLC-SLM 2026 Challenge, which focuses on speaker-attributed transcription for multilingual conversational speech. We propose a cascaded framework consisting of three components: a speaker diarization module, a long-form multilingual ASR module, and a speaker-transcription fusion module. The diarization module is built upon DiariZen and produces speaker-homogeneous segments through local speaker activity estimation and global speaker clustering. The ASR module is based on Qwen3-Omni and generates multilingual transcriptions, while an external CTC-based alignment model provides precise word- and character-level timestamps. Finally, the fusion module combines diarization outputs with timestamped transcriptions to generate speaker-attributed STM outputs. translated_title: 传音面向MLC-SLM 2026挑战赛的说话人归属多语言语音识别系统
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了传音语音团队提交至MLC-SLM 2026挑战赛任务1的方案，该任务聚焦于多语言对话语音的说话人归属转录。我们提出了一个由三个组件构成的级联框架：说话人分离模块、长语音多语言ASR模块以及说话人-转录融合模块。说话人分离模块基于DiariZen构建，通过局部说话人活动估计和全局说话人聚类生成说话人同质的分段。ASR模块基于Qwen3-Omni生成多语言转录，同时外部的基于CTC的对齐模型提供精确的词级和字符级时间戳。最后，融合模块将说话人分离的输出与带时间戳的转录相结合，生成说话人归属的STM输出。在官方评测集上的实验结果证明了所提框架的有效性。
tldr: 传音团队提出由说话人分离、基于Qwen3-Omni的多语言ASR与融合模块组成的级联框架，实现了多语言对话语音的说话人归属转录。
en_tdlr: Transsion's team proposes a cascaded framework combining a DiariZen-based speaker diarization module, a Qwen3-Omni-based multilingual ASR module with CTC alignment for precise timestamps, and a fusion module to achieve speaker-attributed transcription of multilingual conversational speech.
